mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the rank correlation coefficient between the FEDFUNDS trend signal and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate derived from CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% annualized signals accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly inflation rate exceeds 2.5% annualized, or the rank correlation coefficient between the inflation rate signal and 20-day returns is below -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 and decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals a sectoral imbalance where manufacturing expansion is not supported by housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0 and HOUST < 1000.0, or the rank correlation coefficient between the interaction signal and 20-day returns is below -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion (defined by unemployment rate below 5.0% and GDP growth rate above 2.0% annualized), a rise in the federal funds rate signals imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.0% and GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where the late-cycle regime condition is met and FEDFUNDS rises, or the rank correlation coefficient between the FEDFUNDS rise signal and 20-day returns is above -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months, or the rank correlation coefficient between the PAYEMS trend signal and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1000.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential construction sector, which is a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is below 1000.0, or the rank correlation coefficient between the HOUST level signal and 20-day returns is below -0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly growth and decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals a shift in consumer spending from housing to other sectors, indicating economic imbalance and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST < 1000.0, or the rank correlation coefficient between the interaction signal and 20-day returns is below -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 45% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the prior 3 months, or the rank correlation coefficient between the INDPRO trend signal and 60-day returns is below -0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.
